segments.sn9.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kassapagotto kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
segments.sn9.3:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā kassapagotto divāvihāragato aññataraṃ chetaṃ ovadati.
segments.sn9.3:1.3: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā āyasmantaṃ kassapagottaṃ saṃvejetukāmā yenāyasmā kassapagotto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ kassapagottaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn9.3:2.3: Akāle ovadaṃ bhikkhu, mandova paṭibhāti maṃ.
segments.sn9.3:3.3: Dhammasmiṃ bhaññamānasmiṃ, atthaṃ bālo na bujjhati.
segments.sn9.3:4.3: Neva dakkhati rūpāni, cakkhu hissa na vijjatī”ti.
segments.sn9.3:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā kassapagotto tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegamāpādīti.

lines: Ovadatīti so kira migaluddako pātova bhuñjitvā “mige vadhissāmī”ti araññaṃ paviṭṭho ekaṃ rohitamigaṃ disvā “sattiyā naṃ paharissāmī”ti anubandhamāno therassa paṭhamasutte vuttanayeneva divāvihāraṃ nisinnassa avidūrena pakkamati.
“upāsaka, pāṇātipāto nāmesa apāyasaṃvattaniko appāyukasaṃvattaniko, sakkā aññenapi kasivaṇijjādikammena dārabharaṇaṃ kātuṃ, mā evarūpaṃ kakkhaḷakammaṃ karohī”ti āha.
Sopi “mahāpaṃsukūlikatthero kathetī”ti gāravena ṭhatvā sotuṃ āraddho.
Athassa sotukāmataṃ janessāmīti thero aṅguṭṭhakaṃ jālāpesi.

So akkhīhipi passati, kaṇṇehipi suṇāti, cittaṃ panassa “asukaṭṭhānaṃ migo gato bhavissati, asukatitthaṃ otiṇṇo, tattha naṃ gantvā ghātetvā yāvadicchakaṃ maṃsaṃ khāditvā sesaṃ kājenādāya gantvā puttake tosessāmī”ti evaṃ migasseva anupadaṃ dhāvati.
Evaṃ vikkhittacittassa dhammaṃ desentaṃ theraṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ “ovadatī”ti.
Ajjhabhāsīti “ayaṃ thero adāruṃ tacchanto viya akhette vappanto viya attanopi kammaṃ nāseti, etassāpi codessāmi nan”ti abhāsi.
Na passatīti ettha “neva telaṃ na vaṭṭi na dīpakapallikā, therassa pana ānubhāvenāyaṃ jalatī”ti imaṃ kāraṇaṃ na passati.
Satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā tassa janapadassa sulabhabhikkhatāya tattha gantvā viharatīti imamatthaṃ sandhāya “paṭhamasutte vuttanayenevā”ti vuttaṃ.
Ṭhatvāti padānubandhanavasena gamanaṃ upacchinditvā therassa āsannaṭṭhāne ṭhatvā.
Aṅguṭṭhakaṃ jālāpesīti adhiṭṭhānabalena daṇḍadīpikaṃ viya attano aṅguṭṭhakaṃ jālāpesi.
Kāraṇajānanasamatthenāti iminā kāraṇena sattānaṃ sukhaṃ, iminā dukkhanti evaṃ samācaramānena kāraṇaṃ jānituṃ samatthena kammassakatañāṇasampayuttacittenāti attho.
